hook: Have you ever wondered how TikTok knows exactly which video will make you laugh, or how digital wallets like eSewa spot a fake transaction instantly?That is not magic — that is Artificial Intelligence (AI).
concept: In simple terms, AI is a way to teach computers to recognize patterns and make decisions, much like how a human learns from experience. Think of a local farmer predicting the monsoon. A farmer doesn't just guess; they look at the clouds, remember past weather patterns, and make an informed prediction. AI does the exact same thing. But instead of looking at the sky, it looks at data — like millions of past videos or financial records — to predict what you want to watch or if a payment is safe. AI is not a physical robot from a sci-fi movie. It is simply a very fast, very smart software tool that helps us sort through massive amounts of information to solve everyday problems.

quiz.title: Based on what we just read, what is the best way to describe AI?

options.label: A robot that has human feelings.
A computer system trained on data to recognize patterns and make predictions.
A new type of fast internet connection.

feedback.correct: Correct! Patterns, data, predictions, that's AI.
feedback.incorrect: Not quite! Remember the farmer analogy—AI uses data to make predictions.
